title: Hieu Duong
text:
05/2023 - Present: AI Engineer at FPT Smart Cloud

Developed Large Language Models (LLMs) and core engines for AI Agents for real-world applications, such as chatbot systems and recommendation systems.

10/2021 - 05/2023: AI Engineer at Innovation Center - VNPT-AI

Developed information retrieval models for Vietnamese chatbot systems.
Researched intent classification and slot filling for Vietnamese chatbot systems.





Bachelor of Science in Engineering, Posts and Telecommunications Institute of Technology, Hanoi, Vietnam (PTIT), 2017 – 2022.

Major: Information Techonology
Supervisor: Dr. Ngo Xuan Bach, Associate Professor, Vice Dean of Faculty of Information Technology, Posts and Telecommunications Institute of Technology (PTIT), Hanoi, Vietnam. (Personal Home-page)
Awards and Prizes:

1st prize in calculus math at MATH OLYMPIAD FOR STUDENTS, 2018 organized by Vietnam Mathematical Society, Vietnam Unions Of Science And Technology Associations.
1st prize at ACM ICPC – PTIT, 2020 organized by PTIT.
Samsung Algorithm Certificate, sponsored and trained by Samsung & PTIT.






🥉 10/2025: 3rd prize in Vietnamese Legal Document Retrieval Competition at VLSP 2025

Our solution demonstrates high efficiency and effectiveness for Vietnamese legal document retrieval.

Built an AI Agent System for document analysis and reporting.

Built a Hybrid Labeling Platform powered by LLMs.

🥈 2023: 2nd prize in VNPT.AI Hackathon 2023
🥇 2020: 1st prize in ACM ICPC – PTIT 2020
🥇 2018: 1st prize in MATH OLYMPIAD FOR STUDENTS 2018

title: About
text: Hello ! My name is Hieu Duong (Dương Xuân Hiếu in Vietnamese). I’m an AI Engineer at FPT Smart Cloud. My current work focuses on research and development of Large Language Models (LLMs) and AI Agents for real-world applications, such as chatbot systems and recommendation systems. I also conduct research in various fields related to Natural Language Processing (NLP), with a particular focus on Vietnamese (my mother tongue) and English. My research interests include Information Retrieval and Retrieval-Augmented Language Models. In addition to my professional work, I enjoy reading and writing blogs about life experiences and personal reflections.
